_comment: FROZEN PRE-REFIT FEATURE BASELINE for the genius scorer (score_v2). Measured 2026-08-08 (round 39) with the CURRENTLY DEPLOYED weights still in place, so that any future refit is judged against ground that predates it. Fitted data -- do not regenerate after a refit; that would destroy its purpose.
source: fountain_events joined to genius_tags; features recomputed with score_v2.py as deployed
F3_t6_promotion: not measured -- deployed weight is exactly 0.0, contributes nothing

findings.no_feature_is_decaying: F1 +4.4%, F2_roll -3.3%, F4 +503.5%, F5 +7.8% first-5-days vs last-5-days. None shows the monotone decay STRIKING showed.
findings.F2_variance_is_the_window_not_the_fires: Against a reference window FROZEN at 2026-07-15, F2 is pinned at 0.9997 (sd 0.00103, spread 0.0051) -- every fire reads as novel. As deployed with a rolling 50-thought window it ranges 0.6005-0.9167 (sd 0.0598). 99.97% of F2's day-to-day variance is the moving reference window; 0.03% is the fires changing. anti_template measures its own window, not the fire.
findings.striking_decline_is_R28: Per-fire reconstruction with the current weights matches stored scores EXACTLY from 2026-07-28 onward and diverges before -- the signature of R28's weight change (ab1b8a6, 2026-07-27). Applying current weights to pre-R28 fires yields a >=0.5 rate of 0.096-0.177, matching the observed post-R28 0.122-0.187. The features did not change; the weights did.

refit_judging_rule: Judge a refit against the ADJACENT window and against this frozen table, never against a pooled multi-week baseline (see R36 SS3.1 and R34's error). Note F2 cannot be compared across a change in window length at all.
